confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Cape Town price levels, rolled forward to July 2026; not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; hostel and hotel rates vary widely by area and season, so they are less certain. Cocktail and wine were set relative to the beer anchor (cocktail about 3 times beer, wine about 1.7 times beer) because direct recall was weak. FX provenance: the 13 Oct 2026 rate is taken from search-result summaries attributed to RBA exchange-rate pages; I did not open the RBA table. A 14 Oct 2026 figure may also exist, but I could not verify it.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city was supplied. Priced on a Cape Town and South African basis: ZAR price levels for cafes, restaurants, backpacker hostels and hotels, converted at an assumed rate of about R17.5 per USD (general knowledge, not checked). July is winter and usually a lower-demand period for international visitors, so accommodation anchors sit toward the lower-middle of the range.
